database_summary: Soccer (football) dataset containing players, teams, matches, leagues, countries, and time-versioned attributes for players and teams. Matches are events (one per played match). Player_Attributes and Team_Attributes are time-stamped attribute/history tables (multiple rows per entity over time). Player, Team, League, Country are relatively stable descriptive/entity tables. Schema is suitable for queries about player/ team attributes over time, match results, lineups, and odds.

accepted.name: player_latest_attributes
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT pa.id, pa.player_fifa_api_id, pa.player_api_id, pa.date, pa.overall_rating, pa.potential, pa.preferred_foot, pa.attacking_work_rate, pa.defensive_work_rate, pa.crossing, pa.finishing, pa.heading_accuracy, pa.short_passing, pa.volleys, pa.dribbling, pa.curve, pa.free_kick_accuracy, pa.long_passing, pa.ball_control, pa.acceleration, pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.reactions, pa.balance, pa.shot_power, pa.jumping, pa.stamina, pa.strength, pa.long_shots, pa.aggression, pa.interceptions, pa.positioning, pa.vision, pa.penalties, pa.marking, pa.standing_tackle, pa.sliding_tackle, pa.gk_diving, pa.gk_handling, pa.gk_kicking, pa.gk_positioning, pa.gk_reflexes
FROM Player_Attributes pa
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
  FROM Player_Attributes
  GROUP BY player_api_id
) latest ON latest.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id AND latest.max_date = pa.date
accepted.description: For each player_api_id (player), return the most recent Player_Attributes snapshot by date. Use this when you need the current/latest known attributes for a player to join against Match lineups or Player entity rows. | Use for: Join latest player attributes to matches/lineups; List top players by overall_rating using their latest snapshot; Compare player physical attributes (pace/strength) at latest snapshot

accepted.name: team_latest_attributes

SELECT ta.id, ta.team_fifa_api_id, ta.team_api_id, ta.date, ta.buildUpPlaySpeed, ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass, ta.buildUpPlayDribbling, ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass, ta.buildUpPlayPassing, ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass, ta.buildUpPlayPositioningClass, ta.chanceCreationPassing, ta.chanceCreationPassingClass, ta.chanceCreationCrossing, ta.chanceCreationCrossingClass, ta.chanceCreationShooting, ta.chanceCreationShootingClass, ta.chanceCreationPositioningClass, ta.defencePressure, ta.defencePressureClass, ta.defenceAggression, ta.defenceAggressionClass, ta.defenceTeamWidth, ta.defenceTeamWidthClass, ta.defenceDefenderLineClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta

  SELECT team_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date

) latest ON latest.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id AND latest.max_date = ta.date
accepted.description: For each team_api_id (team), return the most recent Team_Attributes snapshot by date. Use when you need the current team tactical/attribute snapshot for comparisons or joining to Match rows. | Use for: Join latest team attributes to matches; Compare team tactical profiles across leagues; Filter matches where teams have a defensive style class

accepted.body_sql:
SELECT id, country_id, league_id, season, stage, date, match_api_id, home_team_api_id, away_team_api_id, home_team_goal, away_team_goal, goal, shoton, shotoff, foulcommit, card, cross, corner, possession, B365H, B365D, B365A, BWH, BWD, BWA, IWH, IWD, IWA, LBH, LBD, LBA, PSH, PSD, PSA, WHH, WHD, WHA, SJH, SJD, SJA, VCH, VCD, VCA, GBH, GBD, GBA, BSH, BSD, BSA

accepted.description: Normalized projection of Match with core identifiers and outcomes. Keeps match-level keys and primary measures (scores and common odds) for straightforward joins and aggregations. Use as a clean match-level relation for analyses. | Use for: Match-level aggregations (goals, odds); Join matches to league/country/team dimensions; Filter matches by season and analyze scores

accepted.name: player_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT id, player_api_id, player_name, player_fifa_api_id, birthday, height, weight
FROM Player
accepted.description: Canonical player dimension with core stable attributes from Player. Use when exposing player descriptive fields for joins to match lineups or attributes. | Use for: Join player names to match lineups; Filter players by height/weight or birthday; Enrich per-match player rows with player_name

accepted.name: match_with_team_names
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT m.id, m.match_api_id, m.date, m.season, m.league_id, m.country_id, m.home_team_api_id, th.team_long_name AS home_team_long_name, th.team_short_name AS home_team_short_name, m.away_team_api_id, ta.team_long_name AS away_team_long_name, ta.team_short_name AS away_team_short_name, m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
LEFT JOIN Team th ON th.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
LEFT JOIN Team ta ON ta.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
accepted.description: Denormalized match-level relation that joins Match to Team to expose home and away team long and short names alongside match identifiers. Useful for reporting and grouping by team names. | Use for: Reports showing match outcomes with team names; Aggregate stats by team_long_name or team_short_name; Filter matches for a given team name

accepted.name: player_appearances_aggregated
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT ml.player_api_id AS player_api_id, ml.season AS season, ml.venue AS venue, COUNT(*) AS appearance_count
FROM match_lineup_player_rows ml
WHERE ml.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ml.player_api_id, ml.season, ml.venue
accepted.description: Counts of appearances per player_api_id by season and venue (home/away), computed from unpivoted lineup rows. Use for season-level player participation summaries and joins to player attributes. | Use for: Rank players by appearances in a season; Compare home vs away appearance distributions; Join to Player to get player_name for top appearance makers
